map.轮椅坡道最大坡度是多少？: What is the maximum slope of a wheelchair ramp?
map.依据 GB 55019-2021，一般坡道不应大于 1:12（约 8.33%）；: Under GB 55019-2021, a general ramp should not be steeper than 1:12 (about 8.33%); a gentle ramp may use 1:20 (5%); where space is constrained the steepest is 1:8 (12.5%), and the maximum rise of a single run must not exceed 0.30m.
map.何时需要设置休息平台？: When is a resting platform required?
map.当坡道水平长度超过 9m 或单段高差超过 0.75m（1:12 情形）时应设休息: A resting platform should be provided when the horizontal length of the ramp exceeds 9m or the single-run rise exceeds 0.75m (in the 1:12 case), and the platform depth should not be less than 1.50m; for the 1:10 case, a horizontal length of 6m and a rise of 0.60m likewise requires segmentation and a platform.
